# Progress

<!-- Generated by `pnpm readme:build`. Edit only inside the hand-written block. -->

media and display · tier 2 · beta · renders on the server and ships no client JavaScript.

<!-- hand-written -->

## When to use

For how far along a task is: an upload, a quota, a step in a long job. It is a neutral
track with a bar in the tone, and a screen reader hears it as a progressbar from 0 to 100.

```tsx
<span id="storage-label">Storage: 7.2 GB of 10 GB</span>
<Progress value={72} tone="warning" aria-labelledby="storage-label" />
<Progress indeterminate aria-label="Loading the report" />
```

**A name is required.** Progress renders no text of its own, so pass `aria-label` or
`aria-labelledby`; the type refuses a Progress with neither. The generated table below
cannot say "one of two", which is why it is said here. `value` is clamped to 0-100 before
it reaches ARIA or the bar, and an `indeterminate` bar announces no value at all. The track
fills its container; give it a fixed width with `className`, as a bar in a file row does.

**Contrast.** The bar takes the tone's text colour (`<tone>-on-soft`), at least 5.6:1 on
the track in every mode, and a `line-strong` outline marks the end of the range at 4.7:1
or more on the page. Under forced colours the track is `Canvas` and the bar `CanvasText`.

<!-- /hand-written -->

## Import

```tsx
import { Progress } from 'topclassui'
```

## Props

Required: `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`. Every other prop below is optional.

| Prop | Required | Type | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aria-label` | **yes**, or `aria-labelledby` | `string` | - | The name read out when no visible text names the bar. |
| `aria-labelledby` | **yes**, or `aria-label` | `string` | - | The id of the visible text that names the bar. |
| `indeterminate` | no | `boolean` | `false` | For a wait of unknown length: no value is announced and a short bar pulses. |
| `size` | no | `xs` \| `sm` \| `md` \| `lg` \| `xl` \| `custom` | `"md"` | The shared size scale, which sets the track height; custom emits none. |
| `tone` | no | `primary` \| `neutral` \| `success` \| `warning` \| `danger` \| `info` | `"primary"` | The colour of the bar; the track stays neutral in every tone. |
| `value` | no | `number`, min 0, max 100 | `0` | How far along, as a percentage; anything outside 0-100 is clamped. |

Anything else is passed to the root element, so standard attributes (`onClick`, `aria-*`, `data-*`, `id`) work. `className` is merged last, so yours wins a conflict, and `ref` is a normal prop.
